title: Federated Learning with Uncertainty Quantification on Pseudo Label Exchange
abstract: arXiv:2611.33395v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: In this work, we investigate federated stochastic operator learning for stochastic partial differential equations (SPDEs), with an emphasis on heterogeneous client data distributions and uncertainty quantification. Federated learning enables clients to collaboratively train models without exchanging their original solution data, but conventional federated averaging can suffer significant performance degradation when client distributions differ, particularly when their input function supports are disjoint. To address these challenges, we propose the Federated Stochastic Operator Network (FedSON), a two-phase framework that combines auxiliary data construction with stochastic operator learning. translated_title: 基于伪标签交换的不确定性量化联邦学习
translated_abstract: 在这项工作中，我们研究了针对随机偏微分方程（SPDEs）的联邦随机算子学习，重点关注客户端数据分布的异构性和不确定性量化。联邦学习使各客户端能够在不交换原始解数据的情况下协作训练模型，但传统的联邦平均方法在客户端分布存在差异时会遭遇显著的性能下降，尤其是当各客户端的输入函数支撑互不相交时。为应对这些挑战，我们提出了联邦随机算子网络，这是一个两阶段框架，将辅助数据构建与随机算子学习相结合。在第一阶段，通过交换本地训练的确定性神经算子及其对应的输入函数来生成伪标签辅助数据，使联邦模型能够在异构输入分布上进行学习，而无需
tldr: 本文提出FedSON两阶段框架，通过交换本地神经算子生成伪标签辅助数据，解决了联邦随机算子学习中客户端数据分布异构（尤其是输入函数支撑互不相交）导致的性能下降问题，并实现了不确定性量化。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes FedSON, a two-phase framework that exchanges locally trained neural operators to generate pseudolabeled auxiliary data, addressing performance degradation from heterogeneous client data distributions (particularly disjoint input function supports) in federated stochastic operator learning for SPDEs with uncertainty quantification.
